head: 5aa850d

smoke.notes: Generator parses clean. Full re-inventory NOT_RUN: requires GITHUB_TOKEN and network (per README usage), both out of scope for this lane. atlas.json itself was parsed instead (keys generated_at_utc, total_repos, pages_fetched, pagination_cap, pagination_cap_hit, families, families_by_stage, family_members, classification, top_motion, notes) — the standing receipt of the last real run (2026-09-29T12:52:35.737Z, 4856 repos).

essence: prior atlas: a 6h scheduled re-inventory of the account with auditable classification and honest UNMEASURED vocabulary — superseded by wave-66, which decomposes ideas, not repo surfaces

ideas.name: the stranger's receipt
ideas.statement: Per the stone standard, a stranger should be able to see what this fleet is and whether it's alive: counts, families, motion, and CI coverage, regenerated by the same account it describes — the atlas is that stranger's first receipt.

ideas.name: classification that shows its work
ideas.statement: Families are name-first then description-scored with a precedence tie-break (jev > latent > moth > qthe > quilt > fleet), and every repo records its evidence [family, stage, matched keywords, language] in atlas.json — 'audit the map, do not trust it blind'.

ideas.name: the UNMEASURED vocabulary
ideas.statement: Honesty laws baked into the generator: CI is probed only on the top-motion slice so absence elsewhere is UNMEASURED, never reported as zero; pagination follows Link headers to exhaustion under a hard cap, and pages_fetched/pagination_cap_hit are receipted so a bounded run can never masquerade as a full inventory.

ideas.name: audit-then-keep
ideas.statement: Suspicions about the synonym tables were settled by deterministic 30-repo hand audits (fleet 25/30, qthe 26/30 — both above the 70% bar, tables kept unchanged), with the misses receipted by name and the confirmed canon-adjective residual (~2%) priced rather than fixed because the stability rule forbids unforced reclassification.

ideas.name: what wave-66 supersedes
ideas.statement: The atlas indexes repo surfaces (families, motion, CI) on a schedule; it cannot say what any work MEANS — wave-66's decomposition atlas supersedes it by decomposing ideas into elementary parts, keeping the atlas as the perimeter fence and the timestamped generated block as its own ledger.

parts.name: atlas.json as the standing receipt
parts.essence: One generated JSON holding generated_at_utc, total_repos, pages_fetched, pagination_cap, pagination_cap_hit, families, families_by_stage, family_members, classification, top_motion, notes — the whole map in one auditable file.
parts.failure_mode: hand-edits would break the receipt chain between runs
parts.evidence: quilt-atlas/atlas.json (keys verified by this lane via node require)

parts.name: marker-bounded generated block
parts.essence: The README carries a generated block between ATLAS:BEGIN/ATLAS:END markers — 'do not hand-edit inside markers' — so prose and generated truth stay separable.
outputs: README block with counts, families, top-motion table
parts.failure_mode: hand-edited generated regions silently drifting from atlas.json
parts.evidence: quilt-atlas/README.md lines 35-70 (markers present in the file as seen)

parts.name: 6h re-inventory loop
parts.essence: One scheduled workflow (atlas.yml) re-inventories every repo every 6 hours and commits the diff — the map only grows truer; nothing is deleted.
outputs: fresh atlas.json + README block, committed as diff
parts.failure_mode: a stale map presented as current
parts.evidence: quilt-atlas/README.md intro + 'Or let the schedule do it: atlas.yml runs every 6h and on demand'

parts.name: Link-header pagination with hard cap
parts.essence: Pagination follows API Link headers (rel=next) until the account is exhausted, bounded by a 120-page hard safety cap; pages_fetched, pagination_cap and pagination_cap_hit are receipted in atlas.json.
parts.gate: hard cap 120 pages; a cap hit must set pagination_cap_hit=true rather than truncate silently
parts.failure_mode: a bounded run masquerading as a full inventory (the pre-v3 40-page pin at 4000)
parts.evidence: quilt-atlas/README.md v3 paragraph; atlas.json notes ('bounded by a hard safety cap of 120 pages (12000 repos)')

parts.name: name-then-description classifier
parts.essence: A repo whose name matches nothing gets a second chance via its description — case-insensitive substring scoring against a small synonym table per family, highest score wins, ties broken by family precedence; still imperfect on purpose.
parts.failure_mode: generic words (agent, lane, receipt, canon, seeds) hoovering unrelated repos — the exact suspicion the audits tested

parts.name: per-repo classification evidence
parts.essence: Every repo records [family, stage in {name,description,none}, matched keywords '|' joined, language] in atlas.json -> classification — every assignment is auditable.
parts.gate: no family assignment without its evidence row
parts.evidence: quilt-atlas/README.md v2 evidence rule; atlas.json notes 'audit the map, do not trust it blind'

parts.name: CI probed on the moving frontier only
parts.essence: CI coverage is measured only on the top-motion slice (API economy); absence of a CI row anywhere else is UNMEASURED, never zero.
parts.gate: absence of measurement must render as UNMEASURED, not 0
parts.failure_mode: reporting 'no CI' for repos never probed
parts.evidence: quilt-atlas/README.md honesty laws; atlas.json notes ('absence elsewhere is UNMEASURED, not zero')

parts.name: fleet keyword audit (54-c)
parts.essence: A deterministic 30-repo sample of the description-stage fleet population (then 1153) read by hand: 25/30 genuinely fleet (83% strict, 27/30 with defensible borderlines) — above the 70% bar, synonym table kept; misses receipted by name (lau-compilers 'agent DSL' tail-match, superinstance-embedder verb-matched 'Seeds').
parts.gate: precision bar 70% must be met to keep the synonym table
parts.failure_mode: hiding sample misses to defend the classifier
parts.evidence: quilt-atlas/README.md 'Fleet keyword audit (54-c)' paragraph; atlas.json notes (keyword surface agent=844, fleet=425, crab=9, lane=6, receipt=6, seeds=2)

parts.name: qthe keyword audit + canon census (55-c)
parts.essence: The queued finding audited: 26/30 genuinely qthe (87% strict, 93% with two receipted tie-zone borderlines); the 'canonical'-adjective suspicion confirmed but bounded — full census of all 25 canon-surface repos found 9 adjective collisions vs 16 genuine noun usages, a residual of ~2% priced rather than fixed.
outputs: keep decision + priced residual + tie-zone examples (strategy-ecology)
parts.gate: family precision >= 70% bar; residual below that is priced, not reclassified
parts.failure_mode: unforced reclassification churn violating the stability rule
parts.evidence: quilt-atlas/README.md 'qthe keyword audit (55-c)' paragraph; atlas.json notes item 6

parts.name: top-motion table as the aliveness interface
parts.essence: The README's table of the 24 most recently pushed repos with their workflow names and last-push UTC timestamps — the stranger's answer to 'is it alive', with a pointer that missing rows are below the motion cut.
parts.failure_mode: reading the table as the full inventory (it is a cut, and says so)
parts.evidence: quilt-atlas/README.md '### Top motion (24 most recently pushed)' table; 'Missing rows in the table are below the motion cut'

parts.name: true-count generated statement
parts.essence: The generated block states the true count — 4856 repos (49 pages, Link-follow cap 120) — instead of pinning at 4000, with the generation timestamp beside it.
parts.failure_mode: a pinned stale count (the v2 cap artifact)
parts.evidence: quilt-atlas/README.md generated block line '**4856 repos** (49 pages, Link-follow cap 120) ... generated 2026-09-29T12:52:35.737Z'

parts.name: honest residue + stability rule
parts.essence: 'other' is honest residue, not failure; families are imperfect on purpose and the stability rule forbids unforced reclassification — precision bars are met or the residual is priced in writing.
outputs: a classifier that changes only under evidence
parts.gate: no reclassification without an audit forcing it
parts.evidence: quilt-atlas/README.md families list ('other — honest residue, not failure') + honesty laws; atlas.json notes ('stability rule forbids unforced reclassification')

cells.expr: generated_at_utc, total_repos, pages_fetched, cap flags, families, classification, notes
rel=next to exhaustion, cap 120, cap_hit receipted
name first, synonym-scored description, precedence tie-break
other = honest residue; stability rule holds

layer_logic.0: substrate = one generated atlas.json + a marker-bounded README block; the map is data first, prose second
layer_logic.1: mechanism = scheduled re-inventory, Link-header pagination under a hard cap, and a two-stage name->description classifier
layer_logic.2: policy = honesty laws: UNMEASURED is not zero, 'other' is residue not failure, no reclassification without an audit (stability rule)
layer_logic.3: interface = the top-motion aliveness table and the true-count block — what a stranger reads first
layer_logic.4: evidence = per-repo classification rows, two 30-repo hand audits with named misses, and a timestamped count — the map shows its work
layer_logic.note: superseded by wave-66: this atlas indexes surfaces; the decomposition atlas decomposes ideas (see quilt-atlas-I5)
